bosses.name: The Warden
bosses.description: The ancient guardian of Entry Tower. It has stood motionless for a thousand years — until now.

bosses.name: Fool's Envoy
bosses.description: Gambit's herald. It wears a grinning mask that changes expression mid-battle.

bosses.name: The Trickster's Eye
bosses.description: A floating eye that sees through all illusions — and creates its own.

bosses.name: Gambit's Mimic
bosses.description: A shapeshifter that copies the form of whoever enters its lair.

bosses.name: Shadow Gambit
bosses.description: Gambit's own shadow, given life by forbidden astral magic.

bosses.name: The Counterfeit King
bosses.description: A false king on a throne of mirrors. Halfway through the dungeon — and twice as smug.

bosses.name: Twisted Oracle
bosses.description: Sees the future, but only shows the worst of it.

bosses.name: Gambit's Specter
bosses.description: The ghost of everyone who gave up inside this dungeon, fused into one.

bosses.name: The Last Ruse
bosses.description: One of Gambit's final traps — a monster that pretends to be a treasure chest.

bosses.name: Gambit's Echo
bosses.description: An echo of Gambit himself — not the real thing, but close enough to kill you.

bosses.name: Gambit, The Deceiver
bosses.description: The trickster in the flesh. After 1000 floors of his games, this is the real prize.

bosses.name: Bronze Sentinel
bosses.description: The Centurion's first gate. A sentinel of hammered bronze who has never lost a post.

bosses.name: Iron Centurion
bosses.description: Fully armored in iron. Every blow it lands rings like a forge strike.

bosses.name: Steel Legionnaire
bosses.description: A veteran of ten thousand battles. Its blade has never dulled.

bosses.name: Obsidian Warlord
bosses.description: Carved from obsidian and given life by war. Pain makes it stronger.

bosses.name: Golden Guard Captain
bosses.description: Half-way guardian. Clad in gilded armor that deflects magic as well as steel.

bosses.name: Blood Centurion
bosses.description: Bathed in the blood of those who failed to reach this floor. Uses it as armor.

bosses.name: Void Legionnaire
bosses.description: A soldier who walked into the Void and came back as something else entirely.

bosses.name: Phantom Marshal
bosses.description: The highest-ranking ghost in the Centurion's army. Commands spectral legions.

bosses.name: Eternal Soldier
bosses.description: Cannot die. Has not stopped fighting since the first age of Astral.

bosses.name: Centurion Prime
bosses.description: The Centurion himself. The dungeon was never a fortress — it was a test to see if anyone deserved to face him.

bosses.name: Astral Wisp Lord
bosses.description: The largest wisp ever recorded. It pulses with unstable astral energy.

bosses.name: The Unbound
bosses.description: A rift entity that broke free of its dimensional prison. It has not calmed down since.

bosses.name: Rift Sovereign
bosses.description: Rules over a pocket dimension inside the tower. The walls bend around it.

bosses.name: The Fractured One
bosses.description: A being that exists in multiple dimensions at once. You can't hit all of it at the same time.

bosses.name: Void Weaver
bosses.description: Weaves threads of void between floors, trapping adventurers in astral silk.

bosses.name: Dimension Tyrant
bosses.description: Claims ownership of every dimension it has passed through. Currently on its third thousand.

bosses.name: Astral Revenant
bosses.description: The ghost of a hero who tried to conquer the Astral Tower. It failed — and became the tower.

bosses.name: Rift Colossus
bosses.description: So large it fills the floor. The tower was built around it, not the other way around.

bosses.name: The Penultimate
bosses.description: The second-to-last obstacle. It knows what comes next, and pities you for not running.

bosses.name: The Gate
bosses.description: Not a monster. Not a creature. A living door between this world and the next — and it does not want to be opened.

bosses.name: First Shade
bosses.description: The first guardian of The End. Ancient beyond memory, and furious about being disturbed.

bosses.name: The Consumed
bosses.description: A hero who descended into this dungeon and was absorbed by the void. Their power remains.

bosses.name: Eternal Shade
bosses.description: A shadow with no owner. It has existed since before Astral had a sun.

bosses.name: The Undying
bosses.description: Has been killed 2,400 times. Counts every one. Stops being polite after floor 200.

bosses.name: Void Sovereign
bosses.description: Rules the Void beyond the dungeon walls. Visits floor 500 personally to greet any who make it this far.

bosses.name: The Weight of Everything
bosses.description: A concept given form. The further you descend, the heavier this becomes.

bosses.name: Memory's End
bosses.description: Feeds on memory. Those who survive forget why they came here in the first place.

bosses.name: The Inevitable
bosses.description: It does not rush. It does not need to. It simply waits for you to make a mistake.

bosses.name: The Last Door
bosses.description: Not the final boss. Just the last thing standing between you and it. No one has made it past.

bosses.name: The Eternal
bosses.description: The end of everything. The dungeon was never the challenge — getting here was. This is the answer to every question Astral has ever asked.

bosses.name: The Last Prayer
bosses.description: A choir of the dead still kneeling before an altar that stopped answering centuries ago. It does not attack out of malice, it attacks because it still believes, and you have interrupted the prayer.
